tags.title: Other vendors' models
tags.meaning: It can use models of other makers than its own (here: through a model gateway).

tags.title: Works through OpenRouter
tags.meaning: One OpenRouter key reaches its models.

tags.title: Works through Vercel AI Gateway
tags.meaning: One Vercel AI Gateway key reaches its models.

tags.title: API key
tags.meaning: It works with an API key of its model's provider.

tags.title: Its maker's sign-in
tags.meaning: It can sign in with its maker's own account (a subscription, a ChatGPT plan, an x.ai account).

tags.title: No account needed
tags.meaning: It works with no key and no sign-in.

tags.title: Free tier
tags.meaning: Its model has a free tier (cited, with the date it was checked).

tags.title: Says what it is doing
tags.meaning: It reports its state to Dozer (OSC 7501): working, waiting for you, done.

tags.title: Resumes after a restart
tags.meaning: Its default session continues the last conversation when it is restarted.

tags.title: Runs on Alpine
tags.meaning: It runs on a musl base (Alpine).

tags.title: Open source
tags.meaning: Its source is published under an open-source licence.

tags.title: Runs without a terminal
tags.meaning: It has a non-interactive mode: one prompt in, the answer out (claude -p, codex exec).
